offer.text: My heart's quite made up about you. There's only one thing left to ask — but a promise like that deserves a ring. Bring me four gold, and let me have it shaped into something forever.

accept.text: Four gold, and then... well. You know what then. Hurry back to me.

decline.text: Take your time. Some things shouldn't be rushed. I'll wait.

in_progress.text: Have you the gold yet? My hands won't stop fidgeting.

ready.text: Gold enough for a ring — and for a promise. You know what I'm asking, don't you?

complete.text: Then it's settled, here and now: it's you, and only you. Whatever comes, we face it together.
